facebookresearch_beanmachine/src/beanmac.build_trace_helper: build a python module that uses trace_helper to convert x/y data into Plotly Scatter traces for MCMC chains

facebookresearch_beanmachine/src/beanmac.compute_effective_sample_size: compute the effective sample size diagnostic for MCMC chains using FFT-based autocorrelation

facebookresearch_beanmachine/src/beanmac.plot_trace_and_autocorr: plot trace and autocorrelation plots for MCMC chains using the trace and autocorr methods on Diagnostics
facebookresearch_beanmachine/src/beanmac.compute_split_r_hat: compute the split R-hat convergence diagnostic for MCMC chains using the split_r_hat method on Diagnostics
